title: Design: Convert to No Charge window asks for the category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with no deposit, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-04-02-confirm.png, iwo-happy-22-22-confirm-category-and-original-work-order.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu in the header.
  3. Click Convert to No Charge.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • A window "Convert work order [number] to No Charge?" opens with the body "Prices, fees and discounts are removed from every line; costs and hours are kept. It closes with a NO CHARGE document instead of an invoice. You can convert it back until it is closed."
  • Below: the required select "Category" (empty), and buttons Cancel then "Convert to No Charge".

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R5: “It opens the confirmation "Convert work order [number] to No Charge?" with the body "Prices, fees and discounts are removed from every line; costs and hours are kept. It closes with a NO CHARGE document instead of an invoice. You can convert it back until it is closed.", the required select "Category" (active No Charge categories; empty by default, "Pick a category" when missing), the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2 when the category requires it, and the buttons Cancel and "Convert to No Charge".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
